room.organization: A compact four-sided dining group is shifted into the brighter east half of the room. A single west-wall cabinet forms a separate serving and storage edge, while the north-west entry opens into an uncluttered cross-room approach.
room.main_path: Enter from the north-west door, pass along the open north side of the cabinet, then approach the table from its north-west quadrant without crossing a chair footprint.
room.protected_open_space: The north-west arrival area and the diagonal route toward the north side of the dining group remain free of furniture.

furniture.placement_rationale: The near-square table is treated as orientation-neutral and is shifted east for side daylight. Its center leaves a broad north-west approach and a dedicated serving side toward the west cabinet.
The north chair faces the table directly and pulls back into the open northern approach without entering the door clearance.
The south chair completes the opposing pair, faces the table, and retains a deep unobstructed pull-back area toward the south wall.
The east chair faces west toward the table. Its pull-back strip stays south of the elevated east-window clearance rather than occupying the daylight opening.
The west chair faces the table and remains well east of the cabinet access strip, leaving a serving passage between storage and dining group.

The serving cabinet backs onto the west wall below the arrival route, faces east into a clear access strip, and avoids turning the room into the bench-and-sideboard pattern used by the formal dining scenes.
